title: fix(spec): the report form's top-level rows use the blocks grid's terms
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9Gqqp1VYZwEqbXEm1YsTjU)_
Fixes #36838
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziH9MVhWYLVCiw5eXB

## 维护者速读

- 报表设计器（英文界面）里报表顶层的四个栏目名改成与联合报表分块表格一致的说法：数据来源、指标、分组、列分组；“指标”和“文件名”两条提示改成与实际运行一致；中文面板的“日期范围”“运行时筛选”两条提示跟上了新的英文说法。
- 属于“报表面板说业务话”这项体验工作的收尾，替用英文界面搭报表的业务管理员解决同一张表单里一个设置有两种叫法的问题。
- 只改了栏目名和提示文字，不改任何可保存的设置；出错最多是某句提示读起来别扭，直接撤回即可。
- 无

## What changes

One form, one vocabulary: the report form's top-level data rows now carry the titles its joined-blocks grid already uses (`report.form.ts` lines 93–96 on main), and two hints now say what the runtime does.

**Label resolution, measured.** The four top-level rows declared no `label`, and `ReportSchema` gives those keys no `.meta({ title })`, so both readers fell through to the key:

- the console form: `SchemaForm.tsx:1931–1934`, `fieldSpec.label`, then the localized schema `title`, then `prettify(name)`;
- the catalog extractor: `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts:2771`, `inlineText(field.label) ?? humanizeFieldPath(path)`.

A form-row `label` is therefore the route (producer-first, no `en` overlay). Each `metadataForms.report.fields.KEY.label` leaf already existed with the humanized text, so no catalog key is added, moved or removed; only its `en` value changes.

| Row (key) | Old en | New en | zh-CN |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `dataset` label | Dataset (prettified key) | Data Source | console overlay 数据来源, unchanged; platform bundle 数据集, unchanged |
| `values` label | Values (prettified key) | Metrics | overlay 指标, unchanged; platform 度量, unchanged |
| `rows` label | Rows (prettified key) | Group By | overlay 分组, unchanged; platform 行, unchanged |
| `columns` label | Columns (prettified key) | Group Columns By | overlay 列分组, unchanged; platform 列, unchanged |
| `values` hint (N2) | The metrics to total or count (from the data source). | The metrics to show, such as totals, counts, averages or ratios (from the data source). | overlay 要统计的指标（来自数据来源）, unchanged; platform 要展示的度量名（来自该数据集）, unchanged |
| `exportOptions.fileNamePrefix` hint (N3) | The start of the downloaded file’s name, used instead of the report name. | The start of the downloaded file’s name. Left empty, the file is named after the report’s label, or its name when it has no label. | overlay and platform: 下载文件名的开头。留空时以报表的显示名称命名，没有显示名称时用名称 (was 下载文件名的开头，用来代替报表名称) |
| `dateRange` hint (N4) | en unchanged | en unchanged | overlay: 打开报表时显示的时间段，以及使用者能否自己选择范围 (was 默认时间段与自定义范围开关。按数据来源里的一个日期分组筛选；只有一个日期分组时可留空) |
| `runtimeFilter` hint (N4) | en unchanged | en unchanged | overlay: 每次显示报表时都会应用的筛选，叠加在数据来源自身的条件之上 (was 渲染时的范围筛选，在查询时以 AND 方式并入) |

- **N3, measured at the runtime:** `ReportExport.tsx:210–217` passes `prefix`, then the localized report `label` with `name` as its fallback, into `buildExportFileName` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/export-filename.ts:58–77`), which takes the prefix first and appends the date and time. The form's own `Label` / `Name` rows are the words the hint now uses (显示名称 / 名称 in zh-CN).
- **N2:** a report metric is any dataset measure (sum, count, average, ratio, derived), so the hint names examples instead of a closed pair.
- **N4:** console overlay only, per the card. `dateRange` was already a hand-worded row (marked 36373); `runtimeFilter` is now marked the same way, because the platform zh-CN row is the ledger-pinned rendering of the older sentence and is left alone.
- **Locale packs:** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` changed only `en`. The `fileNamePrefix` hint is re-translated in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES (it is not one of the six rows #36836 carries). The locales that held the old English as a fill (ar, de, fr, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hant) carry a provenance entry for the leaf, so they serve the new English until translated, which is the repository's rule for a changed source string.
- **Ledgers:** `report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` pins the `en` of four leaves this PR moves (`dataset`, `values`, `rows` labels and the `values` hint). Each row now holds the new English and says why: the label values are still byte-identical to their blocks twins, whose English is now the same string; the `values` hint values promise no narrower set than the new English. No verdict and no translated value changed. `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts` asserted the English of the "Dataset" twin its section heading was rendered from; that assertion now points at the dataset type's own label, which reads the same three words, and the header records why the population did not move.
- Left alone, per the seat route: the slugged section titles `Dataset binding` and `Joined blocks`, every key, type, default and Zod shape.

## Acceptance notes

- The platform zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values for these four labels still read the older dataset vocabulary (数据集 / 度量 / 行 / 列 and their ja-JP and es-ES twins), at the top level and in the blocks grid alike, so each locale stays one vocabulary inside the form. The console's curated panel reads the business words from its own overlay. Moving the platform values to the business wording is a translator pass over both positions together (eight leaves), not part of this rename.
- Overlap with #36836: the `values` hint is one of its six rows. Its English moved again here; its zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values were not touched, so that card should translate against the new English. The `fileNamePrefix` hint is not one of the six and is fully translated here.
- With a label that no longer spells the key, the server-served form shows its machine-name hint beside these four rows (`SchemaForm.tsx:2044–2051`), as it already does for Sort Order. This follows from that rule; it was not checked in a browser.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check was not run locally (one data file, strings only); it is left to CI's Type Check UI.

## Verification

First read, by risk: `packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts` (four labels, two hints); `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (moved `en` sources and their reasons); `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts` (three zh-CN hints).

Two-minute check: open a summary report's metadata form in Studio with the console in English. The data rows read Data Source, Metrics and Group By (Group Columns By on a matrix report), matching the joined-blocks grid, and the File Name hint under Period and export says an empty prefix names the file after the report's label.
